test.create_query: CREATE TABLE key_ifnull (y Nullable(UInt64)) ENGINE = MergeTree ORDER BY ifNull(y, 0) SETTINGS allow_nullable_key = 1
CREATE TABLE key_ifnull_string (s Nullable(String)) ENGINE = MergeTree ORDER BY ifNull(s, '') SETTINGS allow_nullable_key = 1
test.fill_query: INSERT INTO key_ifnull SELECT if(number % 10 = 0, NULL, number) FROM numbers_mt(200000000) SETTINGS max_insert_threads = 8
INSERT INTO key_ifnull_string SELECT if(number % 10 = 0, NULL, toString(number)) FROM numbers_mt(200000000) SETTINGS max_insert_threads = 8
test.query: SELECT count() FROM key_ifnull WHERE y BETWEEN 100000000 AND 120000000
SELECT count() FROM key_ifnull_string WHERE s LIKE '12%'
SELECT count() FROM key_ifnull WHERE isNull(y)
